conflicts_notes: Compiled 2025 bylaws establish Cemetery, Constables, Finance, MLP, Moderator, Planning, Select Board, Clerk and Library as elected; current pages resolve the Tree Warden/Assessor transitions to appointed status. Central Berkshire supplies one four-year Windsor-resident elected seat.
Charter separates president, at-large and precinct council seats; the current Precinct 6 incumbent is appointed to an elected seat and therefore withheld from elected Membership serialization.
Odd-year municipal elections yield Mayor, two at-large councilors, seven ward councilors and seven School Committee seats; regional vocational representation is separately elected for four years.

Current system has one separately elected Mayor, six at-large and five district council seats, plus two at-large and six district School Committee seats; the Mayor also holds an ex-officio school role.
General Bylaws Section II provides eleven direct-voter categories and explicit seat/term counts; holder names are left unresolved without current official 2026 roster/results evidence.
